pillars.label: Why YieldSwarm
pillars.title: Three reasons the network wins
pillars.sub: Not hope-backed compute. Not a rented server. Hardware-owned, agent-driven, economically sustainable.
pillars.p1Body: 22 Antminer Z15 Pro units at Blue Forge Advisors. $0.075/kWh contract-locked, 95% uptime SLA at the colocation level, 99.7% at the network layer. Hardware that shows up every block — not hope-backed.
pillars.p2Body: 13 AI agents orchestrate compute routing, stake optimization, and automated failover. Recovery time objective under 60 seconds. No human in the loop for routine operations — agents handle it.
pillars.p3Body: 60/40 revenue share — foundation receives 60%, YieldSwarm retains 40%. Agent-driven emission optimization projected to add $4K–$6K/month uplift over manual. Year 1 range: $80K–$328K.
